title: Understanding Principal Component Matrix
text: The principal component matrix $P$ is derived from the original data matrix. It represents the data in terms of principal components.

title: Dimensions of the Original Data
text: The original data matrix has dimensions based on the number of visitors and the number of exhibits. How many exhibits are there?

title: Principal Components and Exhibits
text: The number of columns in the principal component matrix $P$ is equal to the number of original features (exhibits) in the data.

title: Counting the Exhibits
text: Count the number of exhibits listed in the data. These are the columns in the original data matrix.
